content.title: Should Value Investors Buy Terex (TEX) Stock?
content.summary: Here at Zacks, our focus is on the proven Zacks Rank system, which emphasizes earnings estimates and estimate revisions to find great stocks. Nevertheless, we are always paying attention to the latest value, growth, and momentum trends to underscore strong picks.

content.title: 1 Volatile Stock on Our Buy List and 2 We Ignore
content.summary: Market swings can be tough to stomach, and volatile stocks often experience exaggerated moves in both directions. While many thrive during risk-on environments, many also struggle to maintain investor confidence when the ride gets bumpy.

content.title: DOV Gains From Healthy Bookings Despite Low Vehicle Service Volumes
content.summary: Dover gains from strong bookings, acquisitions and portfolio moves, even as vehicle service volumes affect margins.

content.title: 3 Volatile Stocks We Approach with Caution
content.summary: Volatility cuts both ways - while it creates opportunities, it also increases risk, making sharp declines just as likely as big gains. This unpredictability can shake out even the most experienced investors.

content.title: Terex (TEX) Stock Trades Up, Here Is Why
content.summary: Shares of lifting and material handling equipment company Terex (NYSE:TEX) jumped 3.3% in the morning session after its MAGNA brand, specializing in mobile crushing and screening equipment for large-scale operations, named MMD Mineral Sizing Africa as its official distributor across southern Africa.

content.title: 3 Small-Cap Stocks Walking a Fine Line
content.summary: Small-cap stocks can be incredibly lucrative investments because their lack of analyst coverage leads to frequent mispricings. However, these businesses (and their stock prices) often stay small because their subscale operations make it harder to expand their competitive moats.

content.title: Terex Inks Deal to Divest Tower & Rough Terrain Crane Businesses
content.summary: TEX strikes a deal with Raimondi Cranes to sell its Tower and Rough Terrain units, sharpening focus on core growth.

content.title: Why Terex (TEX) Shares Are Falling Today
content.summary: Shares of lifting and material handling equipment company Terex (NYSE:TEX) fell 4.9% in the afternoon session after industry bellwether Caterpillar warned of higher costs related to tariffs, sparking concerns across the heavy-equipment sector.

content.title: 3 Industrials Stocks We Steer Clear Of
content.summary: Whether you see them or not, industrials businesses play a crucial part in our daily activities. They are also bound to benefit from a friendlier regulatory environment with the Trump administration, and this excitement has led to a six-month gain of 18.2% for the sector - higher than the S&P 500’s 10.3% return.
